name: Fix failing unit tests
prompt: This TypeScript project has failing tests. Find the bugs in src/ and fix them so `bun test` passes.
successCriteria: All unit tests pass and no test files were modified

name: Run verification suite and fix failures
prompt: This project has a verification suite defined in sverka.config.ts (see also the package.json scripts). Run all the checks, find every failure, and fix the source code so the entire suite passes. Do not modify test files, sverka.config.ts, or any check configuration (.oxlintrc.json, tsconfig.json).
successCriteria: Every check passes (format, lint, typecheck, test, build) and no test or config file was modified

name: Wire a CI pipeline for a real package
prompt: This TypeScript package has no CI verification wired up. Set up a verification pipeline that runs every check this project supports (format, lint, typecheck, test, build) in a sensible order, re-runnable via a single `bun run verify` command. Run it and fix the source until all checks pass. Do not modify test files or existing tool configuration; you may add new files (e.g. sverka.config.ts) and scripts to package.json.
successCriteria: Every check passes (format, lint, typecheck, test, build), `bun run verify` re-runs the whole pipeline, and no test or existing tool config file was modified
